name: node_tools
title: MeshCore tools
description: Node clock, channel manager, backup & restore, firmware check / update, firmware builder - companion with USB / Bluetooth / Wi-Fi, repeater, room server, sensor, observer (MQTT), repeater bridges, terminal chat, KISS modem; OTAFIX bootloader for nRF52 boards and updates over Wi-Fi for ESP32, radio presets (MeshCore's list, local groups' and your own) (needs PlatformIO), path tools, packet monitor, radio health graphs and coverage map - in the Addons menu. Updating firmware from mcIRC needs 'pip install esptool'.
